nolviko.totp.label: Authenticator app
nolviko.totp.title: Two-step verification
nolviko.totp.intro: Besides your password, signing in will ask for a six-digit code from an app on your phone. Someone who learns your password still cannot get in.
nolviko.totp.step_app: Install an authenticator app on your phone, for example Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 2FAS, Aegis or your password manager.
nolviko.totp.step_scan: In the app, add an account and scan this code:
nolviko.totp.manual: Cannot scan? Enter this key in the app instead:
nolviko.totp.step_code: Enter the six-digit code the app shows now.
nolviko.totp.invalid: The code is not correct. Check that the time on your phone is right and try the newest code.
nolviko.totp.active: Signing in asks for a code from your authenticator app.
nolviko.totp.codes_left: {count, plural, =0 {You have no unused recovery codes; create new ones below.} one {You have # unused recovery code.} other {You have # unused recovery codes.}}
nolviko.totp.codes_help: New codes replace all earlier ones. Enter a code from the app to create them.
nolviko.totp.codes_save: Keep these codes somewhere safe, for example in your password manager or on paper. Each one works once instead of a code from the app, if your phone is lost. They are shown only now.
nolviko.totp.disable_help: Signing in will then need only your password. Your recovery codes stop working.
nolviko.totp.disable_invalid: The password or the code is not correct.
